glossary.definition: (1) "Appeal" means all proceedings in which a court reviews or retries a cause determined by another court, or by an administrative officer, agency, board, department, tribunal, commission, or other instrumentality.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context requires a different meaning:

glossary.definition: (2) "Appeal on questions of law" means a review of a cause upon questions of law, including the weight and sufficiency of the evidence.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context requires a different meaning:

glossary.definition: (3) "Appeal on questions of law and fact" or "appeal on questions of fact" means a rehearing and retrial of a cause upon the law and the facts.
glossary.normalized: appeal on questions of law and fact
glossary.scope: (A) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context requires a different meaning:
glossary.term: Appeal on questions of law and fact

glossary.definition: (3) "Appeal on questions of law and fact" or "appeal on questions of fact" means a rehearing and retrial of a cause upon the law and the facts.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in the Revised Code, unless the context requires a different meaning:

glossary.definition: (B) As used in this chapter, "administrative-related appeal" means an appeal to a court of the final order of an administrative officer, agency, board, department, tribunal, commission, or other instrumentality.
